chippy_cook.text: Salt and vinegar? Hold the bag in both hands. The gulls have been watching you since you came in.
Fish and chips were never rationed in the Second World War. The government decided a hot bag of chips was good for morale.
You will meet Chipgulls all over Aberystwyth. They are loud, bold and have never paid for a chip in their lives. Bring a snare, not a sandwich.
